title: Earth mass expression
description: Essential: Correctly derives Earth mass from circular orbit parameters using Newton's second law and universal gravitation.

title: Kepler's third law application
description: Important: Applies Kepler's third law to relate periods of orbits I and II using semi-major axis of ellipse.

title: Semi-major axis identification
description: Important: Correctly identifies semi-major axis of elliptical orbit as (r + kr)/2 = r(1+k)/2.

title: Time fraction calculation
description: Important: Recognizes that A-to-B travel time equals half the period of elliptical orbit (from apogee to perigee).

title: Final time expression
description: Essential: Provides correct simplified expression for travel time t in terms of T, k, and constants.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Shows dimensional analysis confirming expressions have correct units for mass and time.

title: Incorrect semi-major axis
description: Pitfall: Uses r or kr alone as semi-major axis instead of average of apogee and perigee distances.

title: Wrong time fraction
description: Pitfall: Assumes A-to-B time equals T/2 (half of circular period) instead of T'/2 (half of elliptical period).
